q.it: Un server MCP ha bisogno della conferma dell'utente prima di cancellare un record. Come la ottiene nella 2026-07-28?
q.en: An MCP server needs user confirmation before deleting a record. How does it get it in 2026-07-28?

o.it: Invia al client una richiesta elicitation/create su uno stream separato
o.en: It sends the client an elicitation/create request on a separate stream

o.it: Risponde alla tools/call con un InputRequiredResult che contiene la richiesta di elicitation
o.en: It answers tools/call with an InputRequiredResult containing the elicitation request

o.it: Apre una connessione GET verso il client
o.en: It opens a GET connection to the client

o.it: Chiede all'host di riavviare la sessione
o.en: It asks the host to restart the session

x.it: Con MRTR il server non invia richieste: restituisce un InputRequiredResult in risposta alla richiesta del client, che poi riprova con le risposte.
x.en: With MRTR the server sends no requests: it returns an InputRequiredResult in response to the client's request, and the client retries with the answers.

cite.text: *Server-to-client interactions (MRTR). When the server needs input from the client — sampling, elicitation, or roots — it does not send its own JSON-RPC request. It returns an [`InputRequiredResult`][input-required-result] containing `inputRequests`, and the client retries the original request with the matching `inputResponses` (see [Multi Round-Trip Requests][mrtr]):

q.it: Dove dichiara le proprie capability un client conforme alla 2026-07-28?
q.en: Where does a 2026-07-28 client declare its capabilities?

o.it: Una sola volta, nella richiesta initialize
o.en: Once, in the initialize request

o.it: In un header HTTP Mcp-Capabilities su ogni POST
o.en: In an Mcp-Capabilities HTTP header on every POST

o.it: Nel _meta di ogni richiesta (clientCapabilities)
o.en: In the _meta of every request (clientCapabilities)

o.it: Solo nella prima richiesta della connessione
o.en: Only in the first request of the connection

x.it: Senza handshake, ogni richiesta porta le capability del client nel _meta. Il server le dichiara invece in server/discover.
x.en: With no handshake, every request carries the client's capabilities in _meta. The server declares its own in server/discover.

cite.text: Make MCP stateless: remove the `initialize`/`notifications/initialized` handshake. Every request now carries its protocol version and client capabilities in `_meta` (`io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion`, `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities`). Clients SHOULD identify themselves on each request (`io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo`), and servers SHOULD identify themselves in each result's `_meta` (`io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo`). Version mismatches return `UnsupportedProtocolVersionError` (SEP-2575).

q.it: Quale affermazione su server/discover è corretta?
q.en: Which statement about server/discover is correct?

o.it: Il server MUST implementarlo; il client MAY chiamarlo
o.en: The server MUST implement it; the client MAY call it

o.it: Il client MUST chiamarlo prima di ogni altra richiesta
o.en: The client MUST call it before any other request

o.it: È opzionale sia per il server sia per il client
o.en: It is optional for both server and client

o.it: Sostituisce tools/list
o.en: It replaces tools/list

x.it: server/discover è obbligatorio da implementare per i server ma facoltativo da chiamare per i client (utile per scegliere la versione o come probe su stdio).
x.en: server/discover is mandatory for servers to implement but optional for clients to call (useful to pick a version or as a probe over stdio).

cite.text: Add `server/discover`: servers MUST implement this RPC to advertise their supported protocol versions, capabilities, and identity. Clients MAY call it before any other request for up-front version selection, or use it as a backward-compatibility probe on STDIO (SEP-2575).

q.it: Quali due campi fanno parte del risultato di server/discover? (Selezionane due)
q.en: Which two fields are part of the server/discover result? (Select two)

o.it: supportedVersions
o.en: supportedVersions

o.it: sessionId
o.en: sessionId

o.it: capabilities
o.en: capabilities

o.it: clientCapabilities
o.en: clientCapabilities

x.it: DiscoverResult contiene supportedVersions, capabilities, instructions opzionali, serverInfo nel _meta e i campi di caching. Non esistono session ID; clientCapabilities è del client.
x.en: DiscoverResult contains supportedVersions, capabilities, optional instructions, serverInfo in _meta and caching fields. There are no session IDs; clientCapabilities belongs to the client.

cite.text: `supportedVersions`: Protocol versions the server supports. The client should choose one of these for subsequent requests. - `capabilities`: Capabilities the server supports (tools, resources, prompts, etc.) - `_meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo']`: Name and version of the server software. Servers SHOULD include this field. - `instructions`: Optional natural-language guidance for LLMs on how to use this server effectively

q.it: Un server stdio stampa messaggi di debug su stdout e il client smette di funzionare. Qual è la correzione?
q.en: A stdio server prints debug messages to stdout and the client breaks. What is the fix?

o.it: Inviare i log come notifications/message
o.en: Send the logs as notifications/message

o.it: Aggiungere un prefisso # che il client salta
o.en: Add a # prefix that the client skips

o.it: Passare a Streamable HTTP, che tollera i log
o.en: Switch to Streamable HTTP, which tolerates logs

o.it: Scrivere i log su stderr, non su stdout
o.en: Write the logs to stderr, not stdout

x.it: Su stdio, stdout è riservato ai messaggi JSON-RPC delimitati da newline. I log vanno su stderr (il logging di protocollo è deprecato).
x.en: Over stdio, stdout is reserved for newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages. Logs go to stderr (protocol logging is deprecated).

cite.text: *For STDIO-based servers: Never write to stdout. Writing to stdout will corrupt the JSON-RPC messages and break your server. The `print()` function writes to stdout by default, so keep it out of a STDIO server entirely.

q.it: Qual è la sequenza raccomandata per chiudere un server stdio?
q.en: What is the recommended sequence to shut down a stdio server?

o.it: Inviare una notifica di shutdown e attendere la risposta
o.en: Send a shutdown notification and wait for the reply

o.it: Chiudere lo stdin, attendere, poi SIGTERM e infine SIGKILL se necessario
o.en: Close stdin, wait, then SIGTERM and finally SIGKILL if needed

o.it: Inviare SIGKILL subito
o.en: Send SIGKILL immediately

o.it: Chiudere stdout del server
o.en: Close the server's stdout

x.it: La spec stdio prevede: il client chiude lo stdin, attende l'uscita, poi SIGTERM e, se il server non termina, SIGKILL.
x.en: The stdio spec says: the client closes stdin, waits for exit, then SIGTERM and, if the server does not exit, SIGKILL.

cite.text: The client cancels it — close the SSE stream (HTTP) or send `notifications/cancelled` referencing the `subscriptions/listen` request ID (stdio). - The server tears it down (e.g., during shutdown) — it SHOULD send a successful `subscriptions/listen` response to signal a graceful end (see Graceful Closure), then close the stream. - The underlying transport closes (HTTP timeout, TCP disconnect, stdio process exit).

q.it: Quali due header sono obbligatori su OGNI POST verso un endpoint MCP 2026-07-28? (Selezionane due)
q.en: Which two headers are required on EVERY POST to a 2026-07-28 MCP endpoint? (Select two)

o.it: MCP-Protocol-Version
o.en: MCP-Protocol-Version

o.it: Mcp-Session-Id
o.en: Mcp-Session-Id

o.it: Mcp-Method
o.en: Mcp-Method

o.it: Mcp-Name
o.en: Mcp-Name

x.it: MCP-Protocol-Version e Mcp-Method servono su ogni POST. Mcp-Name serve solo su tools/call, resources/read e prompts/get. Mcp-Session-Id non esiste più.
x.en: MCP-Protocol-Version and Mcp-Method are needed on every POST. Mcp-Name is only for tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get. Mcp-Session-Id no longer exists.

cite.text: Every POST request to the MCP endpoint MUST include an `MCP-Protocol-Version` header.

q.it: Un vecchio client invia una GET all'endpoint MCP di un server che supporta solo la 2026-07-28. Cosa dovrebbe rispondere il server?
q.en: An old client sends a GET to the MCP endpoint of a 2026-07-28-only server. What should the server respond?

o.it: 200 con uno stream SSE vuoto
o.en: 200 with an empty SSE stream

o.it: 404 Not Found
o.en: 404 Not Found

o.it: 405 Method Not Allowed
o.en: 405 Method Not Allowed

o.it: 401 Unauthorized
o.en: 401 Unauthorized

x.it: GET e DELETE sull'endpoint MCP sono stati rimossi: un server solo-2026-07-28 SHOULD rispondere 405.
x.en: GET and DELETE on the MCP endpoint were removed: a 2026-07-28-only server SHOULD respond 405.

cite.text: HTTP GET or DELETE to the MCP endpoint: respond with `405 Method Not Allowed`. - An `Mcp-Session-Id` header on a request: ignore it, and do not mint or echo session IDs. - A `Last-Event-ID` header: ignore it; streams are not resumable.

q.it: Lo stream SSE di una tools/call si interrompe a metà per un problema di rete. Cosa deve fare il client?
q.en: The SSE stream of a tools/call breaks halfway due to a network issue. What should the client do?

o.it: Riconnettersi con Last-Event-ID e riprendere lo stream
o.en: Reconnect with Last-Event-ID and resume the stream

o.it: Aprire una GET sull'endpoint per ricevere il resto
o.en: Open a GET on the endpoint to receive the rest

o.it: Aspettare che il server reinvii la risposta sullo stream listen
o.en: Wait for the server to resend the response on the listen stream

o.it: Reinviarla come nuova richiesta con un nuovo id
o.en: Re-issue it as a new request with a new id

x.it: Nella 2026-07-28 la caduta della connessione cancella implicitamente la richiesta e la resumability (Last-Event-ID) non esiste più: la richiesta è persa. Se serve ancora il risultato, il client la reinvia come richiesta nuova con un nuovo id (attenzione ai tool non idempotenti); per lavori che devono sopravvivere a una disconnessione si usa l'estensione Tasks (SEP-2575).
x.en: In 2026-07-28 a dropped connection implicitly cancels the request and stream resumability (Last-Event-ID) no longer exists: the request is lost. If the result is still needed, the client re-issues it as a new request with a new id (careful with non-idempotent tools); work that must survive a disconnect uses the Tasks extension (SEP-2575).

cite.text: Remove SSE stream resumability and message redelivery (the `Last-Event-ID` header and SSE event IDs) from the Streamable HTTP transport. A broken response stream loses the in-flight request; clients MUST re-issue it as a new request with a new request ID (SEP-2575).

q.it: Un server annota il parametro "region" (type string) con x-mcp-header. Cosa fa il client HTTP?
q.en: A server annotates the "region" parameter (type string) with x-mcp-header. What does the HTTP client do?

o.it: Copia il valore nell'header Mcp-Param-{nome} della POST, così i gateway possono instradare
o.en: Copies the value into the POST's Mcp-Param-{name} header so gateways can route

o.it: Toglie il parametro dal body e lo invia solo come query string
o.en: Removes the parameter from the body and sends it only as a query string

o.it: Cifra il valore prima dell'invio, così i gateway non leggono la region
o.en: Encrypts the value before sending so gateways cannot read the region

o.it: Ignora l'annotazione: x-mcp-header è solo documentazione per le persone
o.en: Ignores the annotation: x-mcp-header is documentation for humans only

x.it: x-mcp-header rispecchia il valore in un header Mcp-Param-*; il valore resta anche nel body e deve coincidere (altrimenti HeaderMismatch). Non va usato per dati sensibili.
x.en: x-mcp-header mirrors the value into an Mcp-Param-* header; the value stays in the body too and must match (otherwise HeaderMismatch). It must not be used for sensitive data.

cite.text: A required standard header (`MCP-Protocol-Version`, `Mcp-Method`, `Mcp-Name`) is missing. - A header value does not match the corresponding request body value. For headers that permit the Base64 sentinel encoding (`Mcp-Name` and `Mcp-Param-{Name}`), servers MUST decode encoded values (see Value Encoding) before comparing them to the body value. - A header value contains invalid characters.

q.it: Su quale tipo di proprietà x-mcp-header NON è ammesso?
q.en: On which property type is x-mcp-header NOT allowed?

o.it: string
o.en: string

o.it: number
o.en: number

o.it: integer
o.en: integer

o.it: boolean
o.en: boolean

x.it: x-mcp-header è ammesso solo su integer, string e boolean; number non è permesso. Gli integer devono stare nell'intervallo sicuro (±2^53−1).
x.en: x-mcp-header is only allowed on integer, string and boolean; number is not permitted. Integers must be within the safe range (±2^53−1).

cite.text: MUST only be applied to parameters with primitive types (integer, string, boolean). Parameters with type `number` are not permitted. Integer values MUST be within the safe range for JavaScript (−2^53+1 to 2^53−1)

q.it: Un gateway aggrega due server che espongono entrambi un tool "search". Qual è la strategia indicata dalla spec?
q.en: A gateway aggregates two servers that both expose a "search" tool. What strategy does the spec suggest?

o.it: Tenere solo il tool del server collegato per primo
o.en: Keep only the tool of the first connected server

o.it: Usare serverInfo.name per distinguerli, perché è univoco
o.en: Use serverInfo.name to tell them apart, because it is unique

o.it: Disambiguare, ad esempio con un prefisso che identifica il server
o.en: Disambiguate, for example with a prefix identifying the server

o.it: Chiedere ai server di rinominare i tool a runtime
o.en: Ask the servers to rename the tools at runtime

x.it: L'unicità dei nomi vale solo dentro un server; chi aggrega SHOULD disambiguare (es. prefisso). serverInfo.name non è garantito univoco.
x.en: Name uniqueness only holds within one server; aggregators SHOULD disambiguate (e.g. a prefix). serverInfo.name is not guaranteed to be unique.

cite.text: Tool name uniqueness is scoped to a single server. Clients or proxies that aggregate tools from multiple servers MAY encounter naming collisions (for example, two servers each exposing a `search` tool) and SHOULD implement a disambiguation strategy such as prefixing tool names with a server identifier.

q.it: Un inputSchema non contiene la keyword $schema. Quale dialetto JSON Schema si applica?
q.en: An inputSchema has no $schema keyword. Which JSON Schema dialect applies?

o.it: JSON Schema Draft-04
o.en: JSON Schema Draft-04

o.it: JSON Schema Draft-07
o.en: JSON Schema Draft-07

o.it: Il dialetto di OpenAPI 3.0
o.en: The OpenAPI 3.0 dialect

o.it: JSON Schema 2020-12
o.en: JSON Schema 2020-12

x.it: Senza $schema il default è JSON Schema 2020-12. Un altro dialetto si può indicare esplicitamente con $schema.
x.en: Without $schema the default is JSON Schema 2020-12. Another dialect can be stated explicitly with $schema.

cite.text: Default dialect: When a schema does not include a `$schema` field, it defaults to JSON Schema 2020-12

q.it: Un inputSchema contiene un $ref verso https://schemas.example.com/user.json. Cosa deve fare il client che valida?
q.en: An inputSchema contains a $ref to https://schemas.example.com/user.json. What should the validating client do?

o.it: Scaricare lo schema una volta e tenerlo in cache per le chiamate successive
o.en: Download the schema once and cache it for later calls

o.it: Non dereferenziarlo automaticamente via rete
o.en: Not dereference it automatically over the network

o.it: Rifiutare il tool con errore -32602 perché $ref non è ammesso
o.en: Reject the tool with error -32602 because $ref is not allowed

o.it: Inoltrare il riferimento al modello e lasciare che lo risolva
o.en: Forward the reference to the model and let it resolve it

x.it: La spec vieta di risolvere automaticamente $ref verso URI di rete (rischi SSRF e DoS). Si risolvono solo riferimenti interni secondo le regole di $ref resolution.
x.en: The spec forbids automatically resolving $ref to network URIs (SSRF and DoS risks). Only internal references are resolved, per the $ref resolution rules.

cite.text: JSON Schema 2020-12 permits `$ref` to point at an absolute URI. Implementations MUST NOT automatically dereference `$ref` values that resolve to a network URI.

q.it: Quale chiave di _meta un'azienda può usare liberamente, perché non è riservata?
q.en: Which _meta key can a company use freely, because it is not reserved?

o.it: io.modelcontextprotocol/audit
o.en: io.modelcontextprotocol/audit

o.en: dev.mcp/audit

o.en: com.example.mcp/audit

o.en: traceparent

x.en: Prefixes whose second label is modelcontextprotocol or mcp (io.modelcontextprotocol/, dev.mcp/) and the OpenTelemetry keys are reserved. In com.example.mcp/ the second label is example.

cite.text: However, `com.example.mcp/` is NOT reserved, as the second label is `example`.

q.it: Un server chiede accesso privilegiato perché il client dichiara clientInfo.name = "OfficialAdminClient". È una base valida?
q.en: A server grants privileged access because the client declares clientInfo.name = "OfficialAdminClient". Is that a valid basis?

o.it: No: clientInfo è auto-dichiarato e non verificato
o.en: No: clientInfo is self-reported and unverified

o.it: Sì, se la richiesta arriva su HTTPS
o.en: Yes, if the request arrives over HTTPS

o.it: Sì, perché clientInfo è firmato dall'host
o.en: Yes, because clientInfo is signed by the host

o.it: Sì, ma solo su stdio
o.en: Yes, but only over stdio

x.it: clientInfo e serverInfo servono per display e diagnostica; chiunque può scriverci qualsiasi valore. Le decisioni di sicurezza vanno su autenticazione e autorizzazione.
x.en: clientInfo and serverInfo are for display and diagnostics; anyone can put any value there. Security decisions belong to authentication and authorization.

cite.text: `serverInfo` is self-reported by the server and is not verified by the protocol. It is intended for display, logging, and debugging. Clients SHOULD NOT use it to change their behavior, and SHOULD NOT rely on it for security decisions.

q.it: Un tool dichiara un outputSchema. Quali sono gli obblighi?
q.en: A tool declares an outputSchema. What are the obligations?

o.it: Il client MUST rifiutare risultati non conformi; il server MAY ignorarlo
o.en: The client MUST reject non-conforming results; the server MAY ignore it

o.it: Nessuno: outputSchema è solo documentazione
o.en: None: outputSchema is documentation only

o.it: Il server MUST restituire solo testo
o.en: The server MUST return text only

o.it: Il server MUST restituire structuredContent conforme; il client SHOULD validare
o.en: The server MUST return conforming structuredContent; the client SHOULD validate

x.it: Con outputSchema il server deve produrre structuredContent conforme e il client dovrebbe validarlo. Per compatibilità si include anche il JSON in un TextContent.
x.en: With outputSchema the server must produce conforming structuredContent and the client should validate it. For compatibility the JSON is also included in a TextContent.

cite.text: For backwards compatibility, a tool that returns structured content SHOULD also return the serialized JSON in a TextContent block.

q.it: Cosa vede il modello di un tool prima di decidere di chiamarlo?
q.en: What does the model see about a tool before deciding to call it?

o.it: Il codice sorgente e le dipendenze del tool
o.en: The tool's source code and dependencies

o.it: Nome, descrizione, inputSchema, annotations
o.en: Name, description, inputSchema, annotations

o.it: Lo storico delle chiamate di altri utenti
o.en: Other users' call history

o.it: La voce del tool nel registry ufficiale
o.en: The tool's entry in the official registry

x.it: Il modello riceve le definizioni da tools/list (name, description, inputSchema, annotations). Per questo le descrizioni sono una superficie d'attacco (tool poisoning).
x.en: The model receives definitions from tools/list (name, description, inputSchema, annotations). That is why descriptions are an attack surface (tool poisoning).

q.it: Un server vuole spiegare all'LLM di chiamare sempre validate_schema prima di migrate_schema. Dove conviene scriverlo?
q.en: A server wants to tell the LLM to always call validate_schema before migrate_schema. Where is the best place to write that?

o.it: Nel campo instructions di server/discover
o.en: In the instructions field of server/discover

o.it: In ogni messaggio di errore restituito dal tool
o.en: In every error message the tool returns

o.it: In un header HTTP personalizzato sulla risposta
o.en: In a custom HTTP header on the response

o.it: Nel nome del tool, come prefisso numerico
o.en: In the tool name, as a numeric prefix

x.it: Le server instructions servono proprio a descrivere relazioni e ordine tra tool; l'host di solito le mette nel system prompt. Non garantiscono però il comportamento.
x.en: Server instructions exist precisely to describe relationships and ordering between tools; the host usually puts them in the system prompt. They do not guarantee behavior, though.

cite.text: `instructions`: Optional natural-language guidance for LLMs on how to use this server effectively

q.it: Un team vuole impedire che un tool di pagamento venga chiamato senza conferma, e pensa di scriverlo nelle server instructions. Cosa rispondi?
q.en: A team wants to stop a payment tool from being called without confirmation and plans to write that in the server instructions. What do you answer?

o.it: Va bene: il modello è obbligato a seguire le instructions
o.en: Fine: the model is bound to follow the instructions

o.it: Meglio la descrizione del tool, che il modello deve rispettare
o.en: Better the tool description, which the model must obey

o.it: Le instructions non garantiscono nulla: serve un controllo nell'host
o.en: Instructions guarantee nothing: a host-side control is needed

o.it: Basta readOnlyHint: false, che obbliga il client a chiedere
o.en: readOnlyHint: false is enough, it forces the client to ask

x.it: Le instructions sono testo per l'LLM e non garantiscono il comportamento: mai usarle per controlli critici di sicurezza. Servono regole deterministiche nell'host.
x.en: Instructions are text for the LLM and do not guarantee behavior: never use them for critical security controls. Deterministic rules in the host are needed.

cite.text: For a skill whose entry carries `resources`, the host already holds a complete manifest of the skill's files (Resources); a directory read tells it nothing about that skill's contents that the entry did not. Directory reading earns its place elsewhere: for dynamically generated skills, whose `resources` is `"dynamic"`; for resource trees that are not skills at all; and for obtaining the server's current view of a directory without first refreshing the entry. When a host acting on a skill with a manifest wants to know what `templates/` contains, it MAY answer from the entry alone.

q.it: Un client dichiara un'estensione che il server non supporta. Cosa prevede il framework delle estensioni?
q.en: A client declares an extension the server does not support. What does the extensions framework say?

o.it: Il server deve chiudere subito la connessione
o.en: The server must close the connection immediately

o.it: Si torna al comportamento core oppure si rifiuta con un errore
o.en: Fall back to core behavior or reject with an error

o.it: Il server deve scaricare e installare l'estensione
o.en: The server must download and install the extension

o.it: Il client deve ripetere l'initialize senza l'estensione
o.en: The client must redo initialize without the extension

x.it: Le estensioni sono opt-in: se l'altra parte non le supporta si ricade sul core o, se l'estensione è indispensabile, si rifiuta con un errore.
x.en: Extensions are opt-in: if the other side does not support one, fall back to core or, if the extension is essential, reject with an error.

cite.text: If one side supports an extension but the other doesn't, the supporting side needs to either fall back to core protocol behavior or reject the request with an appropriate error if the extension is mandatory.

q.it: Quale interazione utente è tipica dei prompt, secondo la documentazione MCP?
q.en: Which user interaction is typical for prompts, according to the MCP docs?

o.it: Un dialog di approvazione mostrato prima di ogni invocazione del modello
o.en: An approval dialog shown before each invocation by the model

o.it: Inclusione automatica nel contesto, decisa dal modello stesso
o.en: Automatic inclusion in context, decided by the model itself

o.it: Slash command o command palette scelti dall'utente
o.en: Slash commands or command palettes chosen by the user

o.it: Nessuna: i prompt sono invisibili e li usa solo il server
o.en: None: prompts are invisible and used only by the server

x.it: I prompt sono controllati dall'utente (slash command, palette, pulsanti); i tool dal modello con approvazione; le risorse dall'applicazione.
x.en: Prompts are user-controlled (slash commands, palettes, buttons); tools are model-controlled with approval; resources are application-controlled.

cite.text: Prompts | User-controlled | Interactive templates invoked by user choice | Slash commands, menu options

q.it: Quale di questi messaggi JSON-RPC è una notification MCP valida?
q.en: Which of these JSON-RPC messages is a valid MCP notification?

o.it: Un messaggio con method e id null
o.en: A message with method and a null id

o.it: Un messaggio con method e senza id
o.en: A message with method and no id

o.it: Un array di due richieste (batch)
o.en: An array of two requests (batch)

o.it: Un messaggio con result e senza id
o.en: A message with result and no id

x.it: Le notification non hanno id e non ricevono risposta. L'id null non è ammesso nelle richieste, e il batching non è supportato.
x.en: Notifications have no id and get no response. A null id is not allowed in requests, and batching is not supported.

cite.text: Notifications are sent from the client to the server or vice versa, as a one-way message. The receiver MUST NOT send a response.: Notifications MUST NOT include an ID.

q.it: Un client riceve un risultato di tools/call senza il campo resultType. Come lo interpreta?
q.en: A client receives a tools/call result with no resultType field. How does it interpret it?

o.it: Come input_required
o.en: As input_required

o.it: Come errore di protocollo
o.en: As a protocol error

o.it: Come task
o.en: As a task

o.it: Come complete
o.en: As complete

x.it: resultType assente equivale a "complete". "task" esiste solo con l'estensione Tasks.
x.en: A missing resultType means "complete". "task" only exists with the Tasks extension.

cite.text: For backward compatibility with servers implementing earlier protocol versions, which do not include `resultType`, clients MUST treat an absent `resultType` as `"complete"`.

q.it: Quali affermazioni sono vere per la 2026-07-28? (scegli 2)
q.en: Which statements are true for 2026-07-28? (choose 2)

o.it: Il server non avvia mai richieste JSON-RPC verso il client
o.en: The server never initiates JSON-RPC requests to the client

o.it: Il batching JSON-RPC è supportato su HTTP
o.en: JSON-RPC batching is supported over HTTP

o.it: Un id non può essere riusato tra richieste ancora pendenti
o.en: An id cannot be reused among still-pending requests

o.it: Le notification ricevono una risposta vuota
o.en: Notifications receive an empty response

x.it: Il server risponde soltanto (MRTR sostituisce le richieste server→client). Batching rimosso nella 2025-06-18; gli id devono essere unici tra le richieste pendenti.
x.en: The server only responds (MRTR replaces server→client requests). Batching was removed in 2025-06-18; ids must be unique among pending requests.

cite.text: The server MUST NOT write JSON-RPC _requests_ to `stdout`. Server-to-client interactions are carried in [`InputRequiredResult`][mrtr-input-required] replies; see [Multi Round-Trip Requests][mrtr].

q.it: Quali campi di _meta sono obbligatori su ogni richiesta 2026-07-28?
q.en: Which _meta fields are required on every 2026-07-28 request?

o.it: protocolVersion e clientCapabilities
o.en: protocolVersion and clientCapabilities

o.it: clientInfo e il valore dell'Mcp-Session-Id
o.en: clientInfo and the Mcp-Session-Id value

o.it: protocolVersion, clientInfo e sessionId
o.en: protocolVersion, clientInfo and sessionId

o.it: progressToken e il logLevel richiesto
o.en: progressToken and the requested logLevel

x.it: io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion e io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities sono obbligatori; clientInfo è SHOULD. Non esiste più una sessione.
x.en: io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities are required; clientInfo is SHOULD. There is no session any more.

cite.text: For brevity, the request examples on this page omit the `_meta` request metadata (`io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion`, `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo`, and `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities`). Every request MUST include the required `_meta` fields; see `_meta`.

q.it: Una richiesta arriva senza clientCapabilities in _meta. Cosa risponde il server?
q.en: A request arrives without clientCapabilities in _meta. What does the server answer?

o.it: -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability
o.en: -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability

o.it: -32600 Invalid Request con HTTP 200
o.en: -32600 Invalid Request with HTTP 200

o.it: -32602 Invalid params (HTTP 400)
o.en: -32602 Invalid params (HTTP 400)

o.it: Usa le capability della sessione precedente
o.en: It uses the previous session's capabilities

x.it: Un campo obbligatorio mancante in _meta è -32602. -32021 serve quando il client ha mandato le capability ma manca proprio quella richiesta dall'operazione.
x.en: A missing required _meta field is -32602. -32021 is for when the client sent capabilities but lacks the specific one the operation needs.

cite.text: A request missing any required field is malformed; the server MUST reject it with JSON-RPC error code `-32602` (Invalid params). On HTTP, the response status MUST be `400 Bad Request`.

q.it: Un tool deve ricordare un carrello tra più chiamate. Qual è l'approccio corretto in un protocollo stateless?
q.en: A tool must remember a cart across several calls. What is the correct approach in a stateless protocol?

o.it: Legare il carrello all'Mcp-Session-Id assegnato all'initialize
o.en: Bind the cart to the Mcp-Session-Id assigned at initialize

o.it: Usare sticky sessions sul load balancer per tenerlo in memoria
o.en: Use sticky sessions on the load balancer to keep it in memory

o.it: Salvarlo nel campo clientInfo che il client invia ogni volta
o.en: Store it in the clientInfo field the client sends each time

o.it: Restituire un handle esplicito (es. cart_id) da passare come argomento
o.en: Return an explicit handle (e.g. cart_id) passed as an argument

x.it: Lo stato applicativo si porta con handle espliciti negli argomenti; così qualsiasi istanza può servire la richiesta.
x.en: Application state is carried by explicit handles in arguments, so any instance can serve the request.

cite.text: MCP has no protocol-level session, so a server cannot rely on implicit per-connection state to relate one tool call to the next. Servers that need to maintain state across calls — a shopping cart, an open browser context, a database transaction — should do so by returning an explicit handle from a creation tool and accepting that handle as an argument on subsequent calls.

q.it: Il server risponde -32022 con data.supported = ["2026-07-28"]. Cosa fa il client?
q.en: The server answers -32022 with data.supported = ["2026-07-28"]. What does the client do?

o.it: Riprova con initialize
o.en: Retries with initialize

o.it: Sceglie una versione da supported e ripete la richiesta
o.en: Picks a version from supported and retries the request

o.it: Chiude la connessione e segnala errore all'utente
o.en: Closes the connection and reports an error to the user

o.it: Invia un ping per verificare la connessione
o.en: Sends a ping to check the connection

x.it: UnsupportedProtocolVersionError porta l'elenco delle versioni supportate: il client ne sceglie una e riprova. Un errore moderno riconosciuto esclude il fallback a initialize.
x.en: UnsupportedProtocolVersionError carries the supported versions: the client picks one and retries. A recognized modern error rules out falling back to initialize.

cite.text: In both cases, a recognized modern JSON-RPC error (such as `UnsupportedProtocolVersionError`) identifies a modern server: the client retries with a supported version rather than falling back. Anything else identifies a legacy server.

q.it: Un client dual-era su stdio invia server/discover e non riceve risposta entro il timeout. Cosa deve concludere?
q.en: A dual-era client over stdio sends server/discover and gets no answer before the timeout. What should it conclude?

o.it: Che il server è legacy e deve fare fallback a initialize
o.en: That the server is legacy and it should fall back to initialize

o.it: Che il server è moderno ma lento, quindi deve riprovare all'infinito
o.en: That the server is modern but slow, so it should retry forever

o.it: Che deve inviare l'errore -32022 al server e aspettare
o.en: That it should send error -32022 to the server and wait

o.it: Che stdio non è supportato e deve passare a HTTP
o.en: That stdio is unsupported and it should switch to HTTP

x.it: Errore non moderno o timeout della sonda → server legacy → fallback a initialize. L'era viene ricordata per processo (stdio) o per origin (HTTP).
x.en: A non-modern error or probe timeout → legacy server → fall back to initialize. The era is remembered per process (stdio) or per origin (HTTP).

cite.text: Dual-era | Legacy | Works. stdio: the probe returns a non-modern error or times out, and the client falls back to `initialize`. HTTP: the modern request returns a `4xx` without a recognized modern error body, and the client falls back to `initialize` (and possibly further to the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport).

q.it: Su quali metodi un server può restituire un InputRequiredResult?
q.en: On which methods can a server return an InputRequiredResult?

o.it: Su qualsiasi metodo
o.en: On any method

o.it: Solo su tools/call
o.en: Only on tools/call

o.it: tools/call, resources/read e prompts/get
o.en: tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get

o.it: tools/list, resources/list e prompts/list
o.en: tools/list, resources/list and prompts/list

x.it: MRTR è ammesso solo su tools/call, resources/read e prompts/get.
x.en: MRTR is allowed only on tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get.

cite.text: `Mcp-Name` | `params.name` or `params.uri` | `tools/call`, `resources/read`, `prompts/get` requests

q.it: Come deve essere costruito il retry dopo un InputRequiredResult? (scegli 2)
q.en: How must the retry after an InputRequiredResult be built? (choose 2)

o.it: Nuova richiesta con un nuovo id
o.en: A new request with a new id

o.it: Stesso id della richiesta originale
o.en: Same id as the original request

o.it: inputResponses con le stesse chiavi di inputRequests e requestState identico
o.en: inputResponses with the same keys as inputRequests and an identical requestState

o.it: requestState modificato dal client con le risposte
o.en: requestState modified by the client with the answers

x.it: Il retry è una richiesta nuova (nuovo id), con inputResponses indicizzate dalle stesse chiavi di inputRequests e requestState restituito così com'è.
x.en: The retry is a new request (new id), with inputResponses keyed like inputRequests and requestState echoed unchanged.

cite.text: After the user fills in the form, the client retries the call with a new `id`. The retry carries the user's answers in `inputResponses`, under the same `bookingConfirmation` key as the server's request, and the exact `requestState` value from the result:

q.it: Nel retry MRTR manca una delle risposte richieste. Cosa fa il server?
q.en: In the MRTR retry one requested answer is missing. What does the server do?

o.it: Restituisce -32602
o.en: Returns -32602

o.it: Esegue comunque il tool con valori di default
o.en: Runs the tool anyway with default values

o.it: Restituisce un nuovo InputRequiredResult
o.en: Returns a new InputRequiredResult

o.it: Restituisce isError: true
o.en: Returns isError: true

x.it: Se manca qualcosa, il server chiede di nuovo con un altro InputRequiredResult, non con un errore.
x.en: If something is missing, the server asks again with another InputRequiredResult, not an error.

cite.text: If the client fails to send all the information requested in a previous `InputRequests`, and the missing information is necessary for the server to process the request, the server SHOULD respond with a new `InputRequiredResult` requesting the missing information again, rather than returning an error.

q.it: Un client non ha dichiarato la capability elicitation. Il server può includere una richiesta di elicitation in inputRequests?
q.en: A client has not declared the elicitation capability. Can the server include an elicitation request in inputRequests?

o.it: Sì: il client ignorerà le richieste che non capisce
o.en: Yes: the client will ignore requests it doesn't understand

o.it: No: non può chiedere input per capability non dichiarate
o.en: No: it can't ask for input needing undeclared capabilities

o.it: Sì, purché usi l'elicitation in URL mode
o.en: Yes, as long as it uses URL-mode elicitation

o.it: Sì, ma solo nelle risposte a resources/read
o.en: Yes, but only in responses to resources/read

x.it: Il server non può chiedere input che richiedono capability non dichiarate dal client; se l'operazione ne ha bisogno, risponde -32021.
x.en: The server cannot ask for input requiring capabilities the client did not declare; if the operation needs it, it answers -32021.

cite.text: Servers MUST NOT send an `inputRequests` that the client has not declared support for in its capabilities. For example, if a client does not declare support for `elicitation`, the server MUST NOT include any `elicitation/create` requests in the `inputRequests` field.

q.it: Qual è il primo messaggio sullo stream di subscriptions/listen?
q.en: What is the first message on the subscriptions/listen stream?

o.it: notifications/initialized, come nel vecchio handshake
o.en: notifications/initialized, as in the old handshake

o.it: Una risposta JSON-RPC che contiene il subscriptionId
o.en: A JSON-RPC response containing the subscriptionId

o.it: Un primo notifications/tools/list_changed di sincronizzazione
o.en: An initial notifications/tools/list_changed to sync

o.it: notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged
o.en: notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged

x.it: Il server conferma con notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged indicando cosa ha accettato. Il subscriptionId è l'id JSON-RPC della richiesta listen.
x.en: The server confirms with notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged stating what it accepted. The subscriptionId is the JSON-RPC id of the listen request.

cite.text: The server MUST send `notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged` as the first message carrying the subscription's ID in `_meta` under `io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId`, and MUST NOT send any notification on the subscription before it. On stdio, where every subscription shares one channel, this ordering is defined per subscription ID and not per channel: messages belonging to other subscriptions MAY be interleaved before it.

q.it: Quali messaggi NON viaggiano sullo stream di subscriptions/listen? (scegli 2)
q.en: Which messages do NOT travel on the subscriptions/listen stream? (choose 2)

o.it: Notifiche di progress
o.en: Progress notifications

o.it: notifications/resources/updated per URI sottoscritti
o.en: notifications/resources/updated for subscribed URIs

o.it: Messaggi di log
o.en: Log messages

o.it: notifications/prompts/list_changed
o.en: notifications/prompts/list_changed

x.it: Progress e log restano legati alla richiesta che li genera; lo stream listen porta solo i cambiamenti sottoscritti.
x.en: Progress and logs stay tied to the request that produced them; the listen stream carries only subscribed changes.

cite.text: Long-lived notification streams are obtained by sending a [`subscriptions/listen`][subscriptions-listen] request. The server's response is itself an SSE stream that stays open and delivers the change notifications the client opted in to (such as `notifications/tools/list_changed` or `notifications/resources/updated`). Request-scoped notifications like `notifications/progress` and `notifications/message` are not delivered on the listen stream — they flow only on the response stream of the request they relate to.

q.it: Un client stdio perde la connessione e riavvia il processo server. Cosa deve fare per continuare a ricevere list_changed?
q.en: A stdio client loses the connection and restarts the server process. What must it do to keep receiving list_changed?

o.it: Nulla, la sottoscrizione è persistente
o.en: Nothing, the subscription is persistent

o.it: Inviare di nuovo subscriptions/listen
o.en: Send subscriptions/listen again

o.it: Inviare resources/subscribe
o.en: Send resources/subscribe

o.it: Ripetere initialize
o.en: Repeat initialize

x.it: Su stdio, dopo la riconnessione il client deve reinviare subscriptions/listen. resources/subscribe non esiste più come meccanismo separato.
x.en: Over stdio, after reconnecting the client must resend subscriptions/listen. resources/subscribe no longer exists as a separate mechanism.

cite.text: On stdio, if the connection is terminated and then re-established, the client MUST re-send `subscriptions/listen` to re-establish its subscriptions — the server holds no subscription state across reconnections.

q.it: Come si cancella una richiesta in corso su Streamable HTTP nella 2026-07-28?
q.en: How is an in-flight request cancelled over Streamable HTTP in 2026-07-28?

o.it: Inviando DELETE all'endpoint
o.en: By sending DELETE to the endpoint

o.it: Inviando notifications/cancelled con POST
o.en: By POSTing notifications/cancelled

o.it: Chiudendo lo stream di risposta
o.en: By closing the response stream

o.it: Inviando un nuovo initialize
o.en: By sending a new initialize

x.it: Su HTTP la cancellazione è la chiusura dello stream di risposta; su stdio si usa notifications/cancelled.
x.en: Over HTTP, cancelling means closing the response stream; over stdio notifications/cancelled is used.

cite.text: Streamable HTTP: closing the response stream for the request, which constitutes cancellation. - stdio: sending a `notifications/cancelled` notification referencing the request ID.

q.it: Quale affermazione sulle notifiche di progress è corretta?
q.en: Which statement about progress notifications is correct?

o.it: Il valore progress deve crescere a ogni notifica; total è opzionale
o.en: The progress value must increase with each notification; total is optional

o.it: total è obbligatorio e deve restare uguale in ogni notifica
o.en: total is required and must stay the same in every notification

o.it: progress deve essere un intero tra 0 e 100, come una percentuale
o.en: progress must be an integer between 0 and 100, like a percentage

o.it: Ogni notifica di progress azzera il timeout senza limiti
o.en: Each progress notification resets the timeout without limit

x.it: progress cresce sempre, può essere decimale, total è facoltativo. Il timeout può essere esteso dal progress ma con un massimo assoluto.
x.en: progress always increases, may be decimal, total is optional. Progress may extend the timeout, but with an absolute maximum.

cite.text: The `progress` value MUST increase with each notification, even if the total is unknown. - The `progress` and the `total` values MAY be floating point. - The `message` field SHOULD provide relevant human readable progress information.

q.it: Un server restituisce tools/list con ttlMs: -5. Come lo tratta il client?
q.en: A server returns tools/list with ttlMs: -5. How does the client treat it?

o.it: Come cache infinita
o.en: As infinite caching

o.it: Come 0: niente cache
o.en: As 0: no caching

o.it: Come errore -32602
o.en: As error -32602

o.it: Come 5 ms
o.en: As 5 ms

x.it: ttlMs mancante o negativo vale 0. Il TTL non è un intervallo di polling.
x.en: A missing or negative ttlMs equals 0. The TTL is not a polling interval.

cite.text: If `ttlMs` is `0`, the response SHOULD be considered immediately stale. The client MAY re-fetch every time the result is needed. - If `ttlMs` is positive, the client SHOULD consider the result fresh for that many milliseconds after receiving the response. - If `ttlMs` is absent, clients SHOULD assume a default of `0` (immediately stale) and rely on their own caching heuristics or notifications. This should only occur in older server versions. - If `ttlMs` is negative, clients SHOULD ignore it and treat it as `0`.

q.it: Un risultato di resources/read contiene dati di un singolo utente. Quale cacheScope è corretto?
q.en: A resources/read result contains a single user's data. Which cacheScope is correct?

o.it: public
o.en: public

o.it: shared
o.en: shared

o.it: private
o.en: private

o.it: none
o.en: none

x.it: private = riutilizzabile solo nello stesso contesto di autorizzazione; public = condivisibile tra utenti.
x.en: private = reusable only within the same authorization context; public = shareable across users.

cite.text: `"private"` | The response contains private data that is not meant to be shared between callers. Cached responses MAY be reused for the same authorization context. Caches MUST NOT be shared across authorization contexts (e.g. a different access token requires a different cache).

q.it: Su quali metodi ttlMs e cacheScope sono obbligatori nei risultati? (scegli 2)
q.en: On which methods are ttlMs and cacheScope required in results? (choose 2)

o.it: tools/list
o.en: tools/list

o.it: tools/call
o.en: tools/call

o.it: resources/read
o.en: resources/read

o.it: completion/complete
o.en: completion/complete

x.it: Sono obbligatori su server/discover, i metodi */list (compresi i template) e resources/read; non su tools/call.
x.en: They are required on server/discover, the */list methods (templates included) and resources/read; not on tools/call.

cite.text: Each primitive type has associated methods for discovery (`*/list`), and for either retrieval (`resources/read`, `prompts/get`) or execution (`tools/call`). MCP clients will use the `*/list` methods to discover available primitives. For example, a client can list the available tools (`tools/list`), provide them to a model, and execute the ones that the model calls (`tools/call`). This design allows listings to be dynamic.

q.it: La risposta di una lista paginata non contiene nextCursor. Cosa significa?
q.en: A paginated list response contains no nextCursor. What does it mean?

o.it: Errore del server
o.en: Server error

o.it: Il client deve riprovare con cursor vuoto
o.en: The client must retry with an empty cursor

o.it: La lista è finita
o.en: The list has ended

o.it: La cache è scaduta
o.en: The cache has expired

x.it: nextCursor assente = fine dei risultati. Il cursore è opaco; un cursore non valido dà -32602.
x.en: Missing nextCursor = end of results. The cursor is opaque; an invalid cursor gives -32602.

cite.text: Treat a missing `nextCursor` as the end of results

q.it: Un client chiede resources/read su un URI inesistente. Quale errore restituisce un server 2026-07-28?
q.en: A client calls resources/read on a nonexistent URI. Which error does a 2026-07-28 server return?

o.it: Un risultato con contents vuoto
o.en: A result with empty contents

x.it: Risorsa non trovata = -32602. -32002 era il vecchio codice: i client lo accettano ancora da server più vecchi, ma non va emesso.
x.en: Resource not found = -32602. -32002 was the old code: clients still accept it from older servers, but it must not be emitted.

cite.text: `-32002` — resource not found (2025-11-25 and earlier; replaced by `-32602`). Clients SHOULD still accept `-32002` from servers implementing earlier versions. - `-32042` — URL elicitation required (2025-11-25 only).

q.it: Abbina il codice: -32020 indica…
q.en: Match the code: -32020 means…

o.it: HeaderMismatch
o.en: HeaderMismatch

o.it: UnsupportedProtocolVersion
o.en: UnsupportedProtocolVersion

o.it: MissingRequiredClientCapability
o.en: MissingRequiredClientCapability

o.it: Method not found
o.en: Method not found

x.it: -32020 HeaderMismatch, -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability, -32022 UnsupportedProtocolVersion.
x.en: -32020 HeaderMismatch, -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability, -32022 UnsupportedProtocolVersion.

cite.text: `-32020` | `HeaderMismatch` | The HTTP headers do not match the corresponding values in the request body, or required headers are missing/malformed.

q.it: Un'implementazione vuole un codice di errore personalizzato. Quale intervallo NON deve usare?

o.it: -32020..-32099, riservato alla spec MCP
o.en: -32020..-32099, reserved to the MCP spec

o.en: Codes outside the JSON-RPC reserved range

o.en: None: they are all free

x.it: -32020..-32099 è riservato alla spec; -32000..-32019 è legacy da non usare.
x.en: -32020..-32099 is reserved to the spec; -32000..-32019 is legacy and must not be used.

cite.text: `-32020` to `-32099` — reserved for the MCP specification. Error codes in this sub-range are defined exclusively by the MCP specification and recorded in the schema. Implementations MUST NOT emit any code from this sub-range that is not defined by this specification and MUST use defined codes only with their specified meanings.

q.it: Un tool chiama un'API esterna che risponde 429 Too Many Requests. Come deve rispondere il server MCP?
q.en: A tool calls an external API that answers 429 Too Many Requests. How should the MCP server respond?

o.it: Un errore JSON-RPC -32603 Internal error
o.en: A JSON-RPC -32603 Internal error

o.it: Un HTTP 429 inoltrato al client MCP
o.en: An HTTP 429 forwarded to the MCP client

o.it: Un errore -32602 Invalid params
o.en: A -32602 Invalid params error

o.it: Un risultato con isError: true
o.en: A result with isError: true

x.it: Fallimenti di API, validazione e logica di business sono errori di esecuzione del tool (isError), che il client passa al modello per correggersi.
x.en: API, validation and business logic failures are tool execution errors (isError), which the client passes to the model to self-correct.

cite.text: MCP tool errors arrive as a successful response with `isError: true` rather than a transport failure. Generated wrappers should convert this into a thrown exception so model-authored code can use `try`/`catch`. If an uncaught error terminates the script, surface it as the script's result so the model can self-correct; the model is responsible for reporting any partial side effects already committed.

q.it: Il client chiama tools/call con un nome di tool che non esiste. Che tipo di errore è?
q.en: The client calls tools/call with a tool name that does not exist. What kind of error is it?

o.it: Errore di esecuzione, isError: true
o.en: Execution error, isError: true

o.it: Errore di protocollo -32602
o.en: Protocol error -32602

o.it: Errore -32601 Method not found
o.en: Error -32601 Method not found

o.it: HTTP 404 senza corpo
o.en: HTTP 404 with no body

x.it: Tool sconosciuto = errore di protocollo -32602 (il metodo tools/call esiste, il parametro è invalido).
x.en: Unknown tool = protocol error -32602 (the tools/call method exists, the parameter is invalid).

cite.text: If the requested resource does not exist, servers MUST return a JSON-RPC error with code `-32602` (Invalid Params). Servers SHOULD return `-32603` for internal errors.

q.it: Un server 2026-07-28 non implementa completion/complete e un client lo chiama via HTTP. Cosa risponde?
q.en: A 2026-07-28 server does not implement completion/complete and a client calls it over HTTP. What does it answer?

o.it: 200 con un risultato vuoto
o.en: 200 with an empty result

o.it: 404 Not Found con errore JSON-RPC -32601
o.en: 404 Not Found with JSON-RPC error -32601

o.it: 405 Method Not Allowed senza corpo
o.en: 405 Method Not Allowed with no body

o.it: 400 Bad Request con -32602
o.en: 400 Bad Request with -32602

x.it: Metodo non implementato: 404 con -32601 (MUST). Il corpo JSON-RPC distingue questo caso dal 404 di un vecchio server HTTP+SSE che non ospita l'endpoint moderno. 405 è per GET e DELETE.
x.en: Unimplemented method: 404 with -32601 (MUST). The JSON-RPC body distinguishes this from the 404 of an old HTTP+SSE server that doesn't host the modern endpoint. 405 is for GET and DELETE.

cite.text: If the server does not implement the requested RPC method, it MUST respond with `404 Not Found` and a JSON-RPC error with code `-32601` (`Method not found`). The JSON-RPC error body distinguishes this case from a `404` returned by a legacy [HTTP+SSE][http-sse] server that does not host the modern MCP endpoint (see Backward Compatibility).

q.it: Il token è valido ma non ha gli scope necessari. Quale risposta HTTP è corretta?
q.en: The token is valid but lacks the required scopes. Which HTTP response is correct?

o.it: 401 con WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"
o.en: 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"

o.it: 403 con WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"
o.en: 403 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"

o.it: 400 con errore JSON-RPC -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability
o.en: 400 with JSON-RPC error -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability

o.it: 200 con un risultato del tool che ha isError: true
o.en: 200 with a tool result that has isError: true

x.it: Scope insufficienti = 403 insufficient_scope (step-up). 401 = token mancante, invalido o scaduto.
x.en: Insufficient scopes = 403 insufficient_scope (step-up). 401 = missing, invalid or expired token.

cite.text: If the token is valid but lacks a scope, the server should respond with `403 Forbidden` and an `insufficient_scope` challenge:

q.it: Perché tools/list SHOULD restituire i tool in ordine deterministico?
q.en: Why SHOULD tools/list return tools in a deterministic order?

o.it: Perché la spec vieta la paginazione
o.en: Because the spec forbids pagination

o.it: Per aiutare caching e prompt caching dell'LLM
o.en: To help caching and LLM prompt caching

o.it: Per permettere al server di validare gli argomenti
o.en: To let the server validate arguments

o.it: Perché i nomi dei tool sono ordinali
o.en: Because tool names are ordinal

x.it: Un ordine stabile rende i cataloghi confrontabili e mantiene stabile il prefisso del prompt, migliorando il prompt caching.
x.en: A stable order makes catalogs comparable and keeps the prompt prefix stable, improving prompt caching.

cite.text: Servers SHOULD return tools in a deterministic order (i.e., the same ordering across requests when the underlying set of tools has not changed). Deterministic ordering enables clients to reliably cache the tool list and improves LLM prompt cache hit rates when tools are included in model context.

q.it: Quale campo di un risultato tools/call trasporta dati conformi a outputSchema?
q.en: Which tools/call result field carries data conforming to outputSchema?

o.it: content, in un blocco di testo
o.en: content, inside a text block

o.it: structuredContent
o.en: structuredContent

o.it: annotations del risultato
o.en: annotations of the result

o.it: _meta del risultato
o.en: _meta of the result

x.en: structuredContent holds the structured output validated by outputSchema; content remains for text, images, audio and resources.

cite.text: *Structured content is returned as a JSON value in the `structuredContent` field of a result. This can be any JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null) that conforms to the tool's `outputSchema` if one is defined.

q.it: Un tool non dichiara annotation. Come deve considerarlo il client?
q.en: A tool declares no annotations. How should the client consider it?

o.it: Read-only e chiuso
o.en: Read-only and closed-world

o.it: Distruttivo e open-world
o.en: Destructive and open-world

o.it: Idempotente
o.en: Idempotent

o.it: Non invocabile
o.en: Not callable

x.it: Default pessimistici: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint true, idempotentHint false, openWorldHint true.
x.en: Pessimistic defaults: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint true, idempotentHint false, openWorldHint true.

cite.text: ToolAnnotations: readOnlyHint (Default: false); destructiveHint: If true, the tool may perform destructive updates to its environment (Default: true); idempotentHint (Default: false); openWorldHint (Default: true).

q.it: Un tool ha readOnlyHint: true e destructiveHint: true. Cosa conta?
q.en: A tool has readOnlyHint: true and destructiveHint: true. What counts?

o.it: destructiveHint, perché è il valore più prudente
o.en: destructiveHint, because it is the safer value

o.it: Nessuno: la definizione è invalida e dà -32602
o.en: Neither: the definition is invalid and gives -32602

o.it: readOnlyHint: destructiveHint conta solo se è false
o.en: readOnlyHint: destructiveHint only counts when it is false

o.it: Nessuno: le annotation contraddittorie vanno ignorate
o.en: Neither: contradictory annotations must be ignored

x.it: destructiveHint e idempotentHint hanno significato solo per tool non read-only. Le annotation restano comunque non fidate se il server non è fidato.
x.en: destructiveHint and idempotentHint only mean something for non-read-only tools. Annotations stay untrusted unless the server is trusted.

cite.text: destructiveHint: If true, the tool may perform destructive updates to its environment. If false, the tool performs only additive updates. (This property is meaningful only when readOnlyHint == false) Default: true

q.it: Un tool riceve un handle scaduto. Come risponde il server?
q.en: A tool receives an expired handle. How does the server respond?

o.it: Errore di protocollo -32602
o.en: Protocol error -32602

o.it: HTTP 410 Gone
o.en: HTTP 410 Gone

o.it: Errore di esecuzione del tool (isError: true)
o.en: Tool execution error (isError: true)

o.it: Crea silenziosamente un nuovo handle
o.en: Silently creates a new handle

x.it: Handle scaduto o sconosciuto è un errore di esecuzione: il modello può reagire, ad esempio aprendone uno nuovo.
x.en: An expired or unknown handle is an execution error: the model can react, for example by opening a new one.

cite.text: Expiry errors. A call against an expired or unknown handle should return a tool execution error that says so, so the model can recover by creating a new one.

q.it: Quando un server può restituire un CreateTaskResult?
q.en: When can a server return a CreateTaskResult?

o.it: Sempre, quando l'operazione è lunga
o.en: Always, when the operation is long

o.it: Solo se il client ha dichiarato l'estensione Tasks
o.en: Only if the client declared the Tasks extension

o.it: Solo su stdio, dove la connessione resta aperta
o.en: Only over stdio, where the connection stays open

o.it: Solo se l'operazione supera i 60 secondi
o.en: Only if the operation exceeds 60 seconds

x.it: Senza dichiarazione dell'estensione Tasks il server non restituisce mai un task.
x.en: Without the Tasks extension being declared, the server never returns a task.

cite.text: Before returning a `CreateTaskResult`, verify that the client included the extension in its per-request capabilities. Never return a task to a client that did not declare support.

q.it: Quali metodi esistono nell'estensione Tasks attuale? (scegli 2)
q.en: Which methods exist in the current Tasks extension? (choose 2)

o.it: tasks/get
o.en: tasks/get

o.it: tasks/result
o.en: tasks/result

o.it: tasks/cancel
o.en: tasks/cancel

o.it: tasks/list
o.en: tasks/list

x.it: Ci sono tasks/get, tasks/update e tasks/cancel. tasks/result e tasks/list sono stati rimossi.
x.en: There are tasks/get, tasks/update and tasks/cancel. tasks/result and tasks/list were removed.

cite.text: Polling. The client calls `tasks/get` with the `taskId`. The response carries the current status and, for terminal states, the final result or error.

q.it: Come si espongono risorse parametriche come file:///logs/{date}?
q.en: How are parametric resources like file:///logs/{date} exposed?

o.it: Con resources/templates/list e URI template
o.en: With resources/templates/list and URI templates

o.en: With a separate tool for each possible date

o.it: Con prompts/list e un argomento date
o.en: With prompts/list and a date argument

o.it: Con completion/complete, che genera gli URI
o.en: With completion/complete, which generates the URIs

x.it: resources/templates/list pubblica template RFC 6570; completion/complete può aiutare a completare i parametri.
x.en: resources/templates/list publishes RFC 6570 templates; completion/complete can help fill in parameters.

cite.text: `resources/templates/list` - List resource templates

q.it: prompts/get viene chiamato senza un argomento obbligatorio. Cosa risponde il server?
q.en: prompts/get is called without a required argument. What does the server answer?

o.it: -32602 Invalid params
o.en: -32602 Invalid params

o.it: Un messaggio assistant che chiede l'argomento
o.en: An assistant message asking for the argument

o.it: isError: true
o.en: isError: true

x.en: Invalid name or missing required arguments = -32602. Alternatively the server can ask for input via MRTR.

cite.text: Missing required arguments: `-32602` (Invalid params)

q.it: Quanti valori al massimo può restituire una completion/complete?
q.en: At most how many values can a completion/complete return?

o.it: Nessun limite
o.en: No limit

x.en: At most 100 values per response; total and hasMore are optional.

cite.text: `values`: Array of suggestions (max 100)

q.it: Un server deve ottenere la API key dell'utente per un servizio di terze parti. Quale meccanismo usa?
q.en: A server needs the user's API key for a third-party service. Which mechanism does it use?

o.it: Elicitation in form mode con un campo password
o.en: Form-mode elicitation with a password field

o.it: Elicitation in URL mode verso una pagina del server
o.en: URL-mode elicitation to a server page

o.it: Un argomento del tool
o.en: A tool argument

o.it: Il campo clientInfo
o.en: The clientInfo field

x.it: Il form mode MUST NOT chiedere segreti: le credenziali passano per URL mode, fuori dalla vista del client e del modello.
x.en: Form mode MUST NOT ask for secrets: credentials go through URL mode, out of sight of the client and the model.

cite.text: Credentials obtained via URL mode elicitation are distinct from the MCP server credentials used by the MCP client. The MCP server MUST NOT transmit credentials obtained through URL mode elicitation to the MCP client.

q.it: In URL mode l'utente risponde accept. Cosa significa?
q.en: In URL mode the user answers accept. What does it mean?

o.it: Che il flusso sulla pagina è completato con successo e il token è pronto
o.en: That the flow on the page completed successfully and the token is ready

o.it: Solo che ha acconsentito ad aprire l'URL; l'esito si scopre al retry
o.en: Only that they consented to open the URL; the outcome is discovered on retry

o.it: Che il client ha già ricevuto il token OAuth dalla pagina
o.en: That the client has already received the OAuth token from the page

o.it: Che il server ora può fare passthrough del token dell'utente verso l'API
o.en: That the server can now pass the user's token through to the API

x.it: accept in URL mode è solo consenso ad aprire l'URL. Il server verifica l'esito quando il client riprova la richiesta.
x.en: accept in URL mode is only consent to open the URL. The server checks the outcome when the client retries the request.

cite.text: The response with `action: "accept"` indicates that the user has consented to the interaction. The interaction occurs out of band and the client is not aware of the outcome unless the server sends a completion notification.

q.it: Un server usava sampling per chiamare un LLM. Cosa raccomanda la 2026-07-28?
q.en: A server used sampling to call an LLM. What does 2026-07-28 recommend?

o.it: Spostare il lavoro sull'estensione Tasks
o.en: Move the work to the Tasks extension

o.it: Chiamare direttamente le API del provider LLM
o.en: Call the LLM provider's APIs directly

o.it: Usare elicitation per chiedere al modello dell'utente
o.en: Use elicitation to ask the user's model

o.it: Usare invece includeContext: allServers
o.en: Use includeContext: allServers instead

x.it: Sampling è deprecato: il server chiama direttamente le API del provider. Roots e logging sono deprecati allo stesso modo.
x.en: Sampling is deprecated: the server calls the provider's APIs directly. Roots and logging are deprecated in the same way.

cite.text: Sampling | SEP-2577 | `2026-07-28` | Integrate directly with LLM provider APIs | First revision released on or after 2027-07-28

q.it: Quali elementi sono stati rimossi del tutto nella 2026-07-28? (scegli 2)
q.en: Which items were removed entirely in 2026-07-28? (choose 2)

o.it: ping
o.en: ping

o.it: tools/list
o.en: tools/list

o.it: logging/setLevel
o.en: logging/setLevel

o.it: completion/complete
o.en: completion/complete

x.it: Rimossi: logging/setLevel, ping e notifications/roots/list_changed. tools/list e completion restano.
x.en: Removed: logging/setLevel, ping and notifications/roots/list_changed. tools/list and completion remain.

cite.text: Remove `ping`, `logging/setLevel`, and `notifications/roots/list_changed`. Log level is now set per-request via `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel` in `_meta`; servers MUST NOT emit `notifications/message` for requests that did not include this field (SEP-2575).

q.it: Perché host e utenti devono trattare con cautela anche le sole descrizioni dei tool?
q.en: Why must hosts and users treat even tool descriptions with caution?

o.it: Perché possono superare il limite di token del modello e troncare il system prompt
o.en: Because they can exceed the model's token limit and truncate the system prompt

o.it: Perché i tool equivalgono a esecuzione di codice e le descrizioni non sono fidate se il server non lo è
o.en: Because tools amount to code execution and descriptions are untrusted unless the server is trusted

o.it: Perché le descrizioni sono firmate dal registry e ogni modifica rompe la firma
o.en: Because descriptions are signed by the registry and any change breaks the signature

o.it: Perché il server può cambiarle solo forzando un nuovo handshake initialize
o.en: Because the server can only change them by forcing a new initialize handshake

x.it: I principi di sicurezza dicono che i tool rappresentano esecuzione di codice arbitrario e che descrizioni e annotation vanno considerate non fidate, salvo server fidati. Le descrizioni entrano nel contesto del modello (tool poisoning).
x.en: The security principles say tools represent arbitrary code execution and that descriptions and annotations should be considered untrusted unless from a trusted server. Descriptions enter the model's context (tool poisoning).

cite.text: Tool Safety - Tools represent arbitrary code execution and must be treated with appropriate caution. - In particular, descriptions of tool behavior such as annotations should be considered untrusted, unless obtained from a trusted server. - Hosts must obtain explicit user consent before invoking any tool - Users should understand what each tool does before authorizing its use

q.it: Quali sono responsabilità dell'host secondo i principi di sicurezza? (scegli 2)
q.en: Which are host responsibilities under the security principles? (choose 2)

o.it: Ottenere consenso esplicito prima di esporre dati utente ai server
o.en: Get explicit consent before exposing user data to servers

o.it: Inviare l'intera conversazione a ogni server
o.en: Send the whole conversation to every server

o.it: Ottenere consenso esplicito prima di invocare un tool
o.en: Get explicit consent before invoking a tool

o.it: Fidarsi delle descrizioni dei tool perché scritte dal server
o.en: Trust tool descriptions because the server wrote them

x.it: L'host chiede consenso prima di esporre dati e prima di invocare tool. I server non vedono l'intera conversazione, e le descrizioni dei tool vanno trattate con cautela.
x.en: The host asks for consent before exposing data and before invoking tools. Servers do not see the whole conversation, and tool descriptions must be treated with caution.

cite.text: Tool Safety - Tools represent arbitrary code execution and must be treated with appropriate caution. - In particular, descriptions of tool behavior such as annotations should be considered untrusted, unless obtained from a trusted server. - Hosts must obtain explicit user consent before invoking any tool - Users should understand what each tool does before authorizing its use

q.it: Un server MCP locale su stdio ha bisogno di una API key. Come la ottiene secondo la spec?
q.en: A local stdio MCP server needs an API key. How does it get it per the spec?

o.it: Con il flusso OAuth 2.1 descritto nella spec
o.en: With the OAuth 2.1 flow described in the spec

o.it: Dall'ambiente: variabili d'ambiente o configurazione
o.en: From the environment: env variables or configuration

o.it: Chiedendola con elicitation in form mode
o.en: By asking for it with form-mode elicitation

o.it: Leggendola dal campo clientInfo della richiesta
o.en: By reading it from the request's clientInfo field

x.it: Per stdio la spec di autorizzazione SHOULD NOT essere usata: le credenziali vengono dall'ambiente.
x.en: For stdio the authorization spec SHOULD NOT be used: credentials come from the environment.

cite.text: MCP provides an Authorization framework for use with HTTP. Implementations using an HTTP-based transport SHOULD conform to this specification, whereas implementations using STDIO transport SHOULD NOT follow this specification, and instead retrieve credentials from the environment.

q.it: Quale RFC è deprecato nella 2026-07-28 tra quelli usati dall'autorizzazione MCP?
q.en: Which RFC is deprecated in 2026-07-28 among those used by MCP authorization?

o.it: RFC 9728 (Protected Resource Metadata)
o.en: RFC 9728 (Protected Resource Metadata)

o.it: RFC 8707 (Resource Indicators)
o.en: RFC 8707 (Resource Indicators)

o.it: RFC 7591 (Dynamic Client Registration)
o.en: RFC 7591 (Dynamic Client Registration)

o.it: RFC 9207 (iss)
o.en: RFC 9207 (iss)

x.it: DCR (RFC 7591) è deprecato; il meccanismo preferito è CIMD. RFC 9207 è invece la novità della 2026-07-28.
x.en: DCR (RFC 7591) is deprecated; the preferred mechanism is CIMD. RFC 9207, instead, is new in 2026-07-28.

cite.text: Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) is deprecated as of protocol version `2026-07-28`. New implementations should use Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) instead.

q.it: Un server MCP riceve un token valido emesso per un'altra API dello stesso authorization server. Cosa deve fare?
q.en: An MCP server receives a valid token issued for another API of the same authorization server. What must it do?

o.it: Accettarlo: firma e issuer sono validi
o.en: Accept it: the signature and issuer are valid

o.it: Accettarlo se gli scope coincidono con quelli del tool
o.en: Accept it if the scopes match the requested tool

o.it: Rifiutarlo: l'audience non è il server MCP
o.en: Reject it: the audience is not the MCP server

o.it: Inoltrarlo all'altra API per conto dell'utente
o.en: Forward it to the other API on the user's behalf

x.it: Il server MUST validare l'audience e rifiutare token emessi per altre risorse.
x.en: The server MUST validate the audience and reject tokens issued for other resources.

cite.text: Audience. Your MCP server must reject tokens that weren't issued for it. The `resource` value from the client should become the token's audience, which is the `aud` claim in a JWT. Some products need a setting for this, or let you configure the audience on a scope instead. Others always use their own identifier. In that case, compare the audience with that identifier, and keep your server's URL as the PRM `resource`. The identifier must belong to this MCP server only, so don't share one application registration between servers.

q.it: Perché il token passthrough è vietato? (scegli 2)
q.en: Why is token passthrough forbidden? (choose 2)

o.it: Aggira controlli come rate limit e validazione
o.en: It bypasses controls such as rate limits and validation

o.it: Rende i token troppo lunghi
o.en: It makes tokens too long

o.it: Distrugge audit trail e accountability
o.en: It destroys audit trail and accountability

o.it: Richiede HTTP/2
o.en: It requires HTTP/2

x.it: Verso le API upstream il server agisce come client OAuth separato con il proprio token. Il passthrough rompe confini di fiducia, controlli e tracciabilità.
x.en: Towards upstream APIs the server acts as a separate OAuth client with its own token. Passthrough breaks trust boundaries, controls and traceability.

cite.text: The Security Best Practices document outlines why token audience validation is crucial and why token passthrough is explicitly forbidden.

q.it: Il client riceve 401 con resource_metadata in WWW-Authenticate. Cosa contiene il documento puntato?
q.en: The client receives 401 with resource_metadata in WWW-Authenticate. What does the referenced document contain?

o.it: Un token di accesso temporaneo da usare subito
o.en: A temporary access token to use right away

o.it: La Protected Resource Metadata (authorization_servers)
o.en: The Protected Resource Metadata (authorization_servers)

o.it: La lista dei tool che richiedono autorizzazione
o.en: The list of tools that require authorization

o.it: Il client secret da usare con l'authorization server
o.en: The client secret to use with the authorization server

x.it: Il server MUST pubblicare la PRM (RFC 9728) con almeno un authorization server. Senza resource_metadata si provano i well-known path-specific e poi root.
x.en: The server MUST publish PRM (RFC 9728) with at least one authorization server. Without resource_metadata, the path-specific then the root well-known are tried.

cite.text: MCP servers MUST implement the OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC9728) specification to indicate the locations of authorization servers. The Protected Resource Metadata document returned by the MCP server MUST include the `authorization_servers` field containing at least one authorization server.

q.it: Quale meccanismo di discovery dei metadati dell'AS deve supportare il client?
q.en: Which AS metadata discovery mechanism must the client support?

o.it: Solo RFC 8414
o.en: Only RFC 8414

o.it: Solo OIDC Discovery
o.en: Only OIDC Discovery

o.it: Sia RFC 8414 sia OIDC Discovery
o.en: Both RFC 8414 and OIDC Discovery

o.it: Nessuno: l'AS è configurato a mano
o.en: Neither: the AS is configured manually

x.it: Il client MUST supportare entrambi; l'AS ne implementa almeno uno. L'issuer nei metadati deve coincidere con quello usato per costruire l'URL.
